sous_titre: Milliards de kilowattheures, 2025 réalisé et 2026-2027 prévus

2025.texte: about 4,058 billion kWh (about 4.1 trillion kWh) in 2025, about a 83 billion increase from 2024

2026.texte: We expect electricity sales in the United States to total 4,135 billion kilowatthours (BkWh) in 2026 and 4,211 BkWh in 2027

2027.texte: electricity sales in the United States to total 4,135 billion kilowatthours (BkWh) in 2026 and 4,211 BkWh in 2027
